lead.headline: AB81 picks first. It needs a quarterback. Again.
lead.dek: Justin Herbert is Questionable with a concussion, Sam Darnold is Out and Jalen Hurts is on IR. AB81 holds the No. 1 claim, J.J. McCarthy (17.64 projected) is the best quarterback on the wire, and Big Stric Energy waits Sunday as a 52.7% favorite.
lead.pull: McCarthy outprojects both of AB81’s starting quarterbacks. That isn’t insurance. That’s an upgrade wearing an insurance costume.
body: The weekly edition is up, refreshed overnight with Monday’s full play-by-play. No stat corrections, no changed results: Cherry Blossom still erased a 60.2-point deficit to beat Bad things man bad things 181.4 to 154.56, and AB81 still lost 151.22 to 78.34 with four starters on bye. Read it. Then come back, because the byes are over and this franchise’s next problem is already here.

The quarterback room. AB81 plays in a two-quarterback league and rosters four of them. Justin Herbert is listed Questionable with a concussion. Sam Darnold is Out with a quadriceps injury. Jalen Hurts is on IR with a calf. That leaves Matthew Stafford (13.54 projected) as the only sure thing. If Herbert can’t go, there is no quarterback on the bench to take the slot. This one doesn’t get solved by a lineup shuffle. It gets solved tonight, on the wire.

The backfield is the same story with a safety net. Derrick Henry is Questionable with a concussion and Kyren Williams is Questionable with a toe. The bench has no running back, but it has receivers and a tight end to burn: George Kittle (12.24), Mike Evans (13.71) and DeVonta Smith (14.0) can slide in through a flex shuffle. Henry’s call is due Thu 1:30 PM, Williams’ by Sun 1:25 PM. Even the kicker, Cam Little, is Questionable, with no kicker behind him.

Here’s the good news: AB81 claims first. The order, per Sleeper: AB81, Poochinski, deeboliciouskins, Cherry Blossom, Big Stric Energy, Maye I touch your TDs?, Santa Clara’s Finest, Bad things man bad things. The best quarterback on the wire is J.J. McCarthy, who projects for 17.64 after scoring 14.22 last week. That’s more than Herbert (14.82) or Stafford (13.54). Behind him: Deshaun Watson (16.22), Joe Milton (14.41), Aaron Rodgers (14.12) and Fernando Mendoza (13.98), who scored 23.88 for nobody last week and has been added 141,144 times across Sleeper.

What would I do? McCarthy with the first claim, no debate. Then look at Justice Hill, Henry’s teammate, added 269,577 times this week. And while the front office is in the roster screen: Mark Andrews, AB81’s starting tight end, projects for 7.96 and has been dropped 161,145 times across Sleeper. Kittle projects for 12.24 on the bench. Germie Bernard (8.07) starts at receiver while Evans and Smith sit. There are a lot of points lying around this roster waiting for somebody to pick them up.

Why it matters: Big Stric Energy projects for 154.19 to AB81’s 151.34, a 2.85-point spread, 52.7% to 47.3%. AB81 is at 100% playoff odds, so this is about seeding: 4.5% for a top-two seed. Big Stric Energy is 2-9 and at 3.5%, which makes Sunday its season. A game this close goes to whoever shows up with two healthy quarterbacks. AB81 gets to pick one first.

quick_hits.headline: Maye at 70.8%, the Finest at 25.7%
quick_hits.body: The champ cut Drake Maye for Cam Ward, won, and jumped to 70.8% for the last playoff spot. Santa Clara’s Finest lost by 92.38 to Poochinski and fell to 25.7%; Big Stric Energy is at 3.5%. This week Maye I touch your TDs? is a 43.7% underdog to Cherry Blossom, and the Finest project for 160.53 against Bad things man bad things at 160.54. Three weeks left. Somebody blinks.

quick_hits.headline: What will Poochinski do at tight end?
quick_hits.body: Sam LaPorta (12.72) is Questionable with an ankle and there’s no other tight end on the roster. Poochinski claims second, right behind AB81. Tyler Higbee (8.08 projected, added 99,774 times) is the only tight end on Sleeper’s trending list and he’s on the R.A.T.S. wire. At 99.5% for a top-two seed and a 66.7% favorite over deeboliciouskins, this is a cheap claim for a team that can afford one.

quick_hits.headline: The most-added player in football fits the Finest
quick_hits.body: Bhayshul Tuten (17.45) is Questionable with an undisclosed injury and Kenneth Walker III is Out. Chris Rodriguez Jr., Tuten’s teammate, is the most-added player in Sleeper this week at 497,466, and he’s available in R.A.T.S. The Finest claim seventh in a coin-flip game they need; Blake Corum (11.17) is the in-house fallback, and the Tuten call is due Wed 5:00 PM.

quick_hits.headline: What will Bad things do with Bijan Robinson?
quick_hits.body: Bijan Robinson (18.4) sits behind Ollie Gordon II (12.78), and Matthew Golden (15.43) sits behind Josh Downs (7.8). As set, Bad things man bad things projects for 145.17 against the Finest’s 160.32. Sorted, it’s 160.54 to 160.53, a 0.01-point spread. The Downs call is due Wed 5:00 PM, the Robinson call by Sun 10:00 AM. I’d make both today.

quick_hits.headline: The champ starts the most-dropped player in football
quick_hits.body: Michael Mayer, Maye I touch your TDs?’ starting tight end, has been dropped 277,668 times across Sleeper this week, more than anyone. He projects for 7.04; Harold Fannin Jr. projects for 11.51 on the bench, and Christian Watson (15.95) is there to replace Emmett Johnson (6.5). As set the champ projects for 136.33. At its best, 154.71, against Cherry Blossom’s 161.37. The Johnson call is due Wed 5:00 PM.

quick_hits.headline: Big Stric Energy’s fix is already on the bench
quick_hits.body: Dalton Kincaid is Out with a thumb again, and Tucker Kraft (10.77) is right there; that call is due Wed 5:00 PM. Jalen Coker is Questionable at flex, with Saquon Barkley (13.71, Questionable with an arm) and DK Metcalf (8.84) behind him. Claim fifth, need nothing urgent, and save the energy for AB81.

w12-m1.headline: 2.85 points and a concussion report
w12-m1.blurb: Big Stric Energy 154.19, AB81 151.34, 52.7% Big Stric. Big Stric’s one fix is Kraft for Kincaid. AB81’s depends on Herbert, Henry and Kyren Williams, all Questionable, and on what it does with the first claim tonight.

w12-m2.headline: The champ needs its own bench
w12-m2.blurb: Cherry Blossom 161.37, Maye I touch your TDs? 154.71 at its best and 136.33 as set. 56.3% Cherry Blossom. Brock Bowers is Out, but Travis Kelce starts and Cherry Blossom’s lineup is already its best one.

w12-m3.headline: Poochinski by 18.16 on paper
w12-m3.blurb: Poochinski 180.94, deeboliciouskins 162.78, 66.7% Poochinski. Its only open question is LaPorta. deeboliciouskins has DJ Moore (Questionable, knee) on the bench again.

w12-m4.headline: A 0.01-point spread
w12-m4.blurb: Bad things man bad things 160.54, Santa Clara’s Finest 160.53 at their best. 50% to 50%. The Finest are at 25.7% for the playoffs and need it; Bad things is at 84.7% for a top-two seed. Bijan Robinson decides it if he gets off the bench.

w12-r8-s0.headline: AB81 at QB: Herbert, or the wire?
w12-r8-s0.blurb: Herbert (14.82) is Questionable with a concussion and there’s no healthy quarterback on the bench: Darnold is Out, Hurts is on IR. The answer is a claim tonight, and AB81 claims first. J.J. McCarthy (17.64) outprojects both AB81 starters.

w12-r2-s6.headline: Poochinski at TE: LaPorta or Higbee?
w12-r2-s6.blurb: LaPorta (12.72) is Questionable with an ankle and the bench has no tight end. Tyler Higbee (8.08) is on the wire and Poochinski claims second. Insurance this cheap is how 9-2 teams stay 9-2.

w12-r5-s2.headline: Bad things at RB: Robinson for Gordon
w12-r5-s2.blurb: Bijan Robinson projects for 18.4, Ollie Gordon II for 12.78. In a 0.01-point game, that’s the whole spread several hundred times over. Due Sun 10:00 AM.

w12-r7-s3.headline: The Finest at RB: Tuten or Corum?
w12-r7-s3.blurb: Tuten (17.45) is Questionable, undisclosed. Corum (11.17) is the safe play; Chris Rodriguez Jr. is the claim. Due Wed 5:00 PM, so the Finest won’t get much news before deciding.

w12-r3-s3.headline: Maye at RB: Watson for Emmett Johnson
w12-r3-s3.blurb: Christian Watson (15.95) can take Johnson’s (6.5) spot through a flex shuffle. Drake London (14.74, Questionable) and Fannin (11.51) are the other options. Due Wed 5:00 PM.

w12-r1-s6.headline: Big Stric at TE: Kraft for Kincaid
w12-r1-s6.blurb: Kincaid is Out with a thumb. Kraft projects for 10.77. Due Wed 5:00 PM. The easiest call on the board.
